notes:
Account summary: Flagstone Insight is a mid-market product analytics SaaS (integrations + in-app guidance). Evaluating Redwood for embeddings + chat-powered in-app help. Interest path: start on hosted API for rapid dev, then move to Dedicated (VPC) for production and data isolation. Strong security bar — team expects SOC2 evidence, SSO (SAML), audit logs, KMS integration and retention controls. Data residency: US only (customer data).

Recent convo highlights: 
- 2026-03-02 demo with product + infra — showed hosted API latency ~70-120ms on sample prompts; PM: "needs sub-150ms 95th for support flows".
- 2026-03-04 pricing call w/ finance — flagged ARR band and tradeoffs; price sensitivity around token billing during peak.
- 2026-03-08 security deep-dive w/ infra/security (Diego + Maya + Flagstone sec lead) — asked for SOC2 Type II evidence, snapshot of audit logging, KMS key lifecycle, and VPC peering/egress controls.

Technical requirements / wishlist: 
- Workloads: retrieval-augmented chat for support, embeddings for search, reranking for help results.
- Latency/throughput: target 95th <=150ms for short-chat queries, bursty peaks up to 200req/s for feature launches.
- Model preferences: primarily open models (Llama2-variants, Mistral evaluation), will accept Redwood curated variants; want automatic fallback to smaller model when capacity constrained.
- Routing/fallback: prefer policy to route to Dedicated first, fallback to hosted pooled instances during maintenance.

Security / compliance notes: 
- SOC2: Requesting SOC2 report and scope confirmation; will run vendor risk questionnaire — security team provided a 40-question RFP (drive link).
- SSO/SAML: Requires IdP integration (Okta) + SCIM for user provisioning.
- Audit logs: Must provide token-level request logs for 90 days with export capability.
- Retention controls: data retention policy configurable per-environment, option to purge raw logs after 30/90/365 days.
- KMS: Bring-your-own-key desired for Dedicated; need key rotation details.

POC plan (agreed): 
- Phase 1 (hosted): quick integration using hosted API, validate embeddings quality for product search, measure latency and token cost (2 weeks).
- Phase 2 (dedicated POC): spin up Dedicated VPC trial (2 nodes), run canary traffic, validate VPC peering, KMS integration, audit log export (3-4 weeks).
- Acceptance criteria: consistent 95th latency <=150ms, successful Okta SAML login + SCIM sync, SOC2 artifacts reviewed, audit log export validated.

Pricing / commercial: 
- Flagstone expects a blended quote for POC + MRR commit for Dedicated. Finance wants example month of token usage for sizing. Asking for: "what's the committed baseline for a mid-market plan?"

Open items / blockers: 
- Need SOC2 Type II report and explicit list of in-scope controls (security team blocking until review).
- VPC peering windows — Flagstone cloud operations needs exact maintenance/peering schedule to request firewall changes.
- PO/contractual terms: procurement wants standard DPA + data residency addendum.

Next steps (short): 
- Deliver Dedicated VPC security FAQ (Maya) and share SOC2 artifacts by 2026-03-12.
- Diego to prepare SOW draft + example sizing w/ projected token consumption.
- Schedule SOC2 evidence call w/ Flagstone security (target 2026-03-16).

Notes style: fragmented, copying excerpts from meeting transcripts. Fireflies id attached for 2026-03-02 session.
